title: HB 458 (134th GA) (2021-2022 (134th GA)) — In-person photo ID for voting; also absentee/early voting and special election changes (per news)
operative_text:
Photo ID for in-person voting: will require Ohio voters to use a photo ID card for all elections in-person.
Accepted IDs: [paraphrase only] Ohio driver's license, state ID, certain interim IDs, U.S. passport or passport card, certain military and VA cards; SS cards, birth certificates, out-of-state licences not accepted
Free state ID for residents 17+: [paraphrase only]
Mail-in application deadline shortened to 7 days before Election Day: [paraphrase only]
Mail-ballot identification: [paraphrase only; wording unclear in source]
Changes to absentee and early in-person voting; limits on August special elections: [paraphrase only, per search snippets]
Religious-objection exemption and provisional ballot for voters lacking ID: [paraphrase only, per search snippet of LSC final analysis]
